messages:
anya (support): FYI opening a thread — multiple customers pinged about a billing spike tied to yesterday's eventstore outage. Dash shows ~2M tokens lower than invoices for 2026-03-16. Need quick reconciliation and replay plan. @kai @marta @sam

kai (eng-sre): Thanks. Any specific customers or invoices to start with? Do we see gaps in event ingestion or just downstream aggregation?

anya (support): Initial cs list: org-42, org-89, org-117. Tickets attached with invoice numbers. Dash shows fewer tokens in the realtime "billing_tokens_v2" dashboard than the ledger used to generate invoices.

marta (data-platform): I pulled the raw eventstore for that window. There was a partial retention policy mismatch during the outage; some events were queued and replayed but the metering consumer ACKs failed intermittently. Running quick counts now.

replay-bot: replay-job-237 started for window 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z - 2026-03-16T06:00:00Z on cluster "ingest-prod-a".

kai (eng-sre): If the consumer ACKs failed, the replay might have partially applied and left duplicate detection in limbo. Check the replay job logs for checksum errors. Also confirm whether invoice generation used the reconciled ledger or a pre-replay snapshot.

sam (billing): Invoice generation triggered at 2026-03-17T03:00Z using ledger snapshot v2026-03-16-23:00. If replay completed after that snapshot, invoices wouldn't include replayed tokens. That explains invoices > dashboard. But we need to confirm counts.

marta (data-platform): Quick SQL I ran: ```SELECT customer_id, SUM(token_count) as tokens_raw FROM events WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-16T02:00:00Z' AND event_time < '2026-03-16T06:00:00Z' GROUP BY customer_id;``` For org-42 this yields 1,248,730 tokens. The billing ledger has 1,500,012 for the same window. Something's off: ledger > raw events.

anya (support): ledger > raw events — could be duplicate application from earlier partial replays?

kai (eng-sre): Possible. I scanned replay-job-237 logs and found repeated attempts with different replay IDs. Snippet: ```ERROR ChecksumMismatch: expected 0x3a7f2... got 0x8b1d4... at record 421233``` Looks like the replay tool retried and applied a subset, then another attempt applied overlapping events without idempotency.

marta (data-platform): That would create inflated ledger tokens. Also noticed the consumer emitted `processed=true` for some events but the ledger write path retried and created duplicate ledger rows with distinct `event_apply_id`. Need to dedupe.

sam (billing): For immediate customer-facing answers, can we compute corrected token totals and issue credits? What's our window of impact and delta per org?

kai (eng-sre): Quick mitigation plan: 1) pause any further replays on that window — done (replay-job-237 stopped). 2) run a deterministic dedupe pass joining on `event_id` and canonical `apply_id` to compute authoritative tokens by event_id (not ledger rows). 3) generate corrected ledger snapshot and compare to invoices. 4) if invoices are higher, prepare credit calculations per customer.

marta (data-platform): Repro steps for the dedupe audit (for docs/runbook): 
1. Checkout replay tool `release/1.8.2` (this is what ran).
2. Export raw events: ```pg_dump_query \"SELECT event_id, token_count, raw_payload FROM eventstore.events WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-16T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-16T06:00:00Z'\" > /tmp/events-20260316-02-06.ndjson```
3. Run audit script: ```python tools/dedupe_audit.py --events /tmp/events-*.ndjson --ledger postgres://ledger-read/ledger --out /tmp/dedupe-report.json```
4. Check report fields: `event_id`, `sum_token_per_event`, `ledger_rows`, `duplicates_found`

replay-bot: audit completed: duplicates_found=1372, suspect_rows=1389, total_duplicate_tokens=254,182

anya (support): That number matches the delta for org-89 in the cs ticket (they reported ~250k extra tokens).

sam (billing): Next steps for customer comms: Prepare temporary credit for impacted invoices and an explanation draft. I'll hold credits pending final reconciliation. Need final reconciled numbers by EOD.

kai (eng-sre): For backfill we should re-run replay with `--idempotent-apply` flag that uses `event_id` upsert semantics and skips records that already applied. Also patch the replay runner to incrementally checkpoint `replay_attempt_id` so duplicates don't reapply on retry.

marta (data-platform): I'm running the idempotent replay in dry-run mode on a staging snapshot now. Command: ```./bin/replay --window '2026-03-16T02:00:00Z/2026-03-16T06:00:00Z' --idempotent-apply --dry-run --output /tmp/replay-dryrun.json``` Expected runtime ~45m on staging.

ops-oncall: Heads-up — ensure this replay doesn't contend with normal ingestion. Recommend using consumer-group `replay-isolated` and throttle to 100 rps.

marta (data-platform): Noted. I'll use `--consumer-group=replay-isolated --max-rps=100`. Also will snapshot ledger before applying.

replay-bot: idempotent-replay-dryrun finished. Predicted duplicate_tokens_removed=254,180. Predicted ledger_delta_per_org: org-42:+0, org-89:-250,182, org-117:+1,998

kai (eng-sre): Good. Action items: 
- marta: run idempotent replay against prod snapshot with throttling and ledger snapshot (owner: marta, ETA: 2026-03-17 18:30 UTC).
- sam: prepare provisional credits email draft (owner: sam, ETA: 2026-03-17 20:00 UTC).
- anya: consolidate CS tickets and update customers with interim note (owner: anya, ETA: 2026-03-17 19:00 UTC).

marta (data-platform): Started prod apply with flags and checkpoints. Command logged to ops channel.

replay-bot: prod-replay-239 started. Applying with idempotent mode.

ops-oncall: Monitoring token ingestion and consumer lag. Set alert on `ledger_write_rate` and `duplicate_row_rate`.

marta (data-platform): Prod apply complete. Post-apply reconciliation SQL: ```WITH canonical AS (SELECT event_id, MAX(token_count) as token_count FROM events GROUP BY event_id) SELECT customer_id, SUM(token_count) as tokens FROM canonical JOIN events e USING (event_id) GROUP BY customer_id;``` Results match expected amounts.

replay-bot: reconciliation report uploaded: /var/replays/reports/reconcile-20260317-239.json (md5: 9f8b2c3a)

sam (billing): Final corrected deltas: org-42: 0, org-89: -250,182 tokens (credit), org-117: +1,998 tokens (charge adjustment). I'll compute prorated USD credits and run through finance review.

anya (support): Sending interim update to org-89 and attaching root cause: replay tool retries caused duplicate ledger rows; we've applied idempotent replay and will credit the overcharged amount.

kai (eng-sre): Filed a PR to make `--idempotent-apply` the default for replay tool and add a gating check to prevent overlapping replay IDs. Link: https://github.com/redwood/replay/pull/542

marta (data-platform): Postmortem notes I'll add: cause, detection, mitigation steps, follow-ups (hardening replay idempotency, telemetry on duplicate_row_rate, ops checklist for replay window). Will WIP the doc in /docs/incidents/ after this thread.

anya (support): Thanks team. Closing thread when PR merged and credits issued.

sam (billing): Marking as pending until finance clears the credits.

kai (eng-sre): Closing from eng side — will follow up on the replay tool PR review. :thumbsup:

anya (support): Closing — final message: customers updated, credits queued, replay fix merged to staging. Will reopen if any regressions.
